title: fix: wire ViewConfigPanel draft to ObjectView for real-time preview + inline filter/sort/column editors
body:
`objectViewSchema` hardcoded `showSearch: true` and `showFilters: true`, ignoring the ViewConfigPanel draft state. Toggling switches in the config panel had no visible effect until Save was clicked. Additionally, the filter, sort, and column rows were read-only clickable summaries that required navigating to sub-editors — they now use the unified inline components for direct editing.

### Changes

- **ObjectView.tsx — `objectViewSchema`**: Read `showSearch`/`showFilters` from `activeView` (which merges draft) instead of hardcoded `true`
- **ObjectView.tsx — `handleViewUpdate`**: New callback propagates each field change to `viewDraft` state immediately, wired to `ViewConfigPanel` via `onViewUpdate`
- **ObjectView.tsx — `PluginObjectView` views prop**: Memoized merged views array (`useMemo` keyed on `[views, activeViewId, viewDraft]`) injects draft into active view entry, preventing unnecessary re-renders
- **ViewConfigPanel.tsx — `useEffect` dep**: Changed from `[activeView]` → `[activeView.id]` to prevent the draft/dirty reset loop when parent re-renders with merged draft
- **ViewConfigPanel.tsx — Inline FilterBuilder**: Replaced the read-only filter summary row with the unified `FilterBuilder` component, with a robust spec-style filter bridge that parses all `@objectstack/spec` formats: single triplets `['field','=',value]`, nested arrays `[['f','=',v],...]`, logic prefixes `['and'|'or',...]`, and object-style `{field, operator, value}`
- **ViewConfigPanel.tsx — Operator mapping**: Bidirectional mapping between spec operators (`=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `in`, etc.) and FilterBuilder operator IDs (`equals`, `notEquals`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `in`, etc.) so operators render and save correctly
- **ViewConfigPanel.tsx — Field type normalization**: `normalizeFieldType()` maps ObjectUI field types (`currency`→`number`, `datetime`→`date`, `picklist`→`select`, `boolean`→`boolean`, etc.) so FilterBuilder shows correct operator sets and input types
- **ViewConfigPanel.tsx — Inline SortBuilder**: Replaced the read-only sort summary row with the unified `SortBuilder` component, with a data bridge converting between the view's flat sort array and `SortItem[]` format
- **ViewConfigPanel.tsx — Column selector**: Replaced the read-only column count row with a `Checkbox` list of all fields from `objectDef`, with proper `CheckedState` handling (`c === true`)
- **ViewTabBar.tsx**: Fixed pre-existing TypeScript build errors blocking CI (DraggableAttributes cast, redundant visibility comparison, implicit any on event handlers)

### Tests

- Three tests for real-time draft propagation: dirty state persistence on same-ID re-render, reset on view switch, and multi-field real-time propagation
- Tests for inline FilterBuilder rendering and interaction (condition count, add filter)
- Tests for inline SortBuilder rendering and interaction (sort item count, add sort)
- Tests for column checkbox toggle updating draft columns
- Tests for spec-style filter parsing: nested arrays, and/or logic prefix, field type normalization
- 50 tests pass total (1 pre-existing skip)

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*

> <issue_title>ObjectView右侧配置面板变更后主视图未实时响应（objectViewSchema未消费draft）</issue_title>
> <issue_description># 问题说明
> 当前在ViewConfigPanel中切换Switch或输入框，虽然本地draft已发生变化，但左侧主视图（PluginObjectView）没有自动实时反映这些更改。场景典型例子为 showSearch 和 showFilters 被硬编码为 true，没有跟随当前draft。这样导致用户误以为配置已经生效，但实际只有点击"保存"后才能见到变化，影响所见即所得体验。
> 
> # 复现路径
> 1. 打开某对象的数据页面，进入视图配置面板
> 2. 修改如"启用搜索"、"启用筛选"等Switch
> 3. 观察左侧主视图并未立即响应变化（除非点击保存后刷新）
> 
> # 代码精确定位
> - apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx
>   - `objectViewSchema` 处的 `showSearch`/`showFilters` 是硬编码
>   - `ViewConfigPanel` 没有传递 `onViewUpdate`
> 
> # 建议修复方案
> - 将 ViewConfigPanel 的 onViewUpdate 回调透传到 ObjectView 的 useState，将 draft 变动实时合并到 activeView。
> - objectViewSchema 的 useMemo 依赖 activeView，把 UI 行为数据源切换至 draft(或activeView)而非常量。
> - PluginObjectView 的 views 属性也需注入draft后的view数据，避免原始views不变。
> 
> # 验收/测试点
> - 改动任意交互项，主视图同步联动（无需点击保存）
> - 更新 ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx 增加相关渲染断言
> - 保持未保存draft不会被后端持久化，仅前端reactive
